name: Nadan Kozhi Varuthathu (Kerala Fried Chicken)
instructions: 1. Clean and wash the chicken pieces thoroughly.
2. In a bowl, mix ginger-garlic paste, red chili powder, turmeric, pepper powder, garam masala, salt, rice flour, cornstarch, and a splash of coconut oil to form a thick paste.
3. Coat the chicken pieces thoroughly with the masala and let them marinate for at least 30-45 minutes.
4. Heat coconut oil in a deep pan or heavy-bottomed kadai.
5. Once the oil is hot, add fresh curry leaves and gently place the marinated chicken pieces.
6. Fry on medium heat until the chicken is cooked through and turns deep red and crispy on the outside.
7. Drain on paper towels and serve hot.
description: Nadan Kozhi Varuthathu is a staple of Kerala cuisine, often served as an appetizer or a side dish for meals. It is distinguished by the heavy use of coconut oil, which provides a unique aroma, and fresh curry leaves that add an earthy fragrance, making it a popular dish in toddy shops and households across the state.
